caption: The video captures a calm lake at dawn, viewed from a fixed vantage behind a wooden dock that extends into the water on the right. A white speedboat with a red center stripe is moored alongside the dock on the left, a dark rounded shape resting at its stern. The far shore is lined with pine and deciduous trees, their forms mirrored in the glassy water below. A bright sun glow sits low on the left horizon, holding steady in position and brightness. Across the open water between the dock and the tree line, a horizontal band of mist drifts gently. This fog slowly shifts and subtly changes shape and density, sliding over the surface. The dock, boat, and trees remain fixed, with no ripples or wake disturbing the still water.
